description: Save a complete, structured, versioned Program Brief (BRD). The previous active version is archived, the rendered markdown mirror is updated, and revenue impact is computed server-side. This replaces the retired free-form anyforge_write_program_brief tool. Requires problemStatement and solutionSummary.

context.description: Current system context and prior decisions.

financialModel.description: Optional monthly impact model. Revenue-at-risk is computed by AnyForge.

naSections.description: Optional sections explicitly marked not applicable.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Performance, availability, accessibility, and other quality targets.

problemStatement.description: The business problem and who has it.

solutionSummary.description: The proposed solution at a glance.

userStories.description: User stories with testable acceptance criteria.

story.description: As a…, I want…, so that…

name: anyforge_save_program_brief_version
title: Save program brief version
